items.text: Every case draws on public sources checked up to 25 October 2026. Events from 2026, including MNT-Halan’s EGX listing, Moove’s exit from Nigeria and NALA’s credit facility, rely on press reports close to that date.
LemFi’s Series B extension of about €30M and M-KOPA’s Series F of about $160M had been reported but not announced as closed at that date.

The offer and the figures attributed to it (520+ vehicles, 20,000+ rentals and ₦2B+ paid to owners) come from company materials and are company-reported. The offer’s amount, instrument, title holder and any return guarantee are not public, so the case leaves its classification unresolved.
